# Hrant Dink Foundation

> The Hrant Dink Foundation promotes human rights, minority rights, and cultural heritage preservation through research, education, and dialogue initiatives in Turkey and the Armenian diaspora.

The foundation honors journalist and human rights advocate Hrant Dink through programs spanning cultural preservation, educational scholarships, international awards, and community engagement across Turkish, Armenian, and Western Armenian languages. Based in Istanbul's historic Anarad Hığutyun Building, it operates as a civil society organization dedicated to fostering dialogue and documenting minority heritage.

## Key Topics

- [Anasayfa - Hrant Dink Vakfı](https://hrantdink.org/tr): Turkish homepage with foundation overview and programs
- [Գլխավոր Էջ - Հրանտ Դինք Հիմնադրամ](https://hrantdink.org/hy): Armenian homepage with cultural heritage and programs
- [Գլխավոր Էջ - Հրանդ Տինք Հիմնարկ](https://hrantdink.org/hyw): Western Armenian homepage with language preservation and foundation information

## Core Programs and Initiatives

- [23,5 Hrant Dink Hafıza Mekânı - Hrant Dink Vakfı](https://hrantdink.org/tr/hafiza-mekani): Memorial site and cultural center dedicated to Hrant Dink with museum and guided tours
- [Uluslararası Hrant Dink Ödülü - Hrant Dink Vakfı](https://hrantdink.org/tr/uluslararasi-hrant-dink-odulu): International Hrant Dink Award for human rights and civil society advocacy
- [Bolis - Hrant Dink Vakfı](https://hrantdink.org/tr/bolis): Project on Armenian culture, minority rights, and Istanbul Greek community heritage
- [Asulis - Hrant Dink Vakfı](https://hrantdink.org/tr/asulis): Project on hate speech, civil society, and media analysis for human rights
- [Faaliyetler - Hrant Dink Vakfı](https://hrantdink.org/tr/faaliyetler): Foundation activities on human rights, education, and Turkey-Armenia dialogue

## About the Foundation

- [Vizyon ve Misyon - Hrant Dink Vakfı](https://hrantdink.org/tr/hakkimizda/vizyon-ve-misyon): Foundation vision and mission on human rights, minority rights, and cultural heritage
- [Hrant Dink - Hrant Dink Vakfı](https://hrantdink.org/tr/hrant-dink): Biography of Hrant Dink, journalist and human rights advocate for minorities
- [Kurumsal Yapi - Hrant Dink Vakfı](https://hrantdink.org/tr/hakkimizda/kurumsal-yapi): Organizational structure with board members and foundation leadership information
- [Ekip - Hrant Dink Vakfı](https://hrantdink.org/tr/hakkimizda/ekip): Foundation team members and staff directory with administrative contact information
- [Kurumsal Belgeler - Hrant Dink Vakfı](https://hrantdink.org/tr/hakkimizda/kurumsal-belgeler): Institutional documents including governance, financial reports, and nonprofit transparency
- [Destekçiler - Hrant Dink Vakfı](https://hrantdink.org/tr/hakkimizda/destekciler): Foundation supporters and partnerships for major programs and initiatives

## Facilities and Venues

- [Tarihçe - Hrant Dink Vakfı](https://hrantdink.org/tr/hakkimizda/anarad-higutyun-binasi/tarihce): History of Anarad Hığutyun Building and Armenian Catholic heritage
- [Havak Salonu - Hrant Dink Vakfı](https://hrantdink.org/tr/hakkimizda/anarad-higutyun-binasi/havak-salonu): Havak Hall event space with conference facilities and live streaming capabilities
